issues.detail: The Hebrew 'אֵל רֳאִי' means 'God of seeing' or 'God who sees me', not '看臺的神' (God of the watchtower). The Chinese rendering changes the meaning from God who sees to a place of watching.

The phrase 'הֲגַם הֲלֹם רָאִיתִי אַחֲרֵי רֹאִי' is rendered as '我豈不是在看臺之後還看見了嗎？' which misinterprets 'אַחֲרֵי רֹאִי' (after the one who sees me) as 'after the watchtower'. The correct meaning is 'Have I also seen after the one who sees me?' or 'Have I even seen here after seeing him?'
